description: Danielson App Import: import github.com/bodangren/hdkwa-danielson as apps/danielson in one snapshot commit of c047df1 with no source history, replace the Danielson Framework text with own-word paraphrases and own-word labels (no exact Danielson Framework text), move its open Measure tracks into the root registry, remove the duplicate files, join the npm workspaces, move the app to the repository toolchain (vinext 1.x, oxlint, oxfmt, tsrs), and deploy a static export to the new Cloudflare Worker danielson. Depends on vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114 (S1, S2) and prod-deploy-pipeline_20261114 (S3 only). Runs before the track set unified-math-app_20261114.

sprint.goal: apps/danielson builds with the repository toolchain, holds no exact Danielson Framework text (only own-word paraphrases, own-word labels, and the element IDs), has no source history, and serves each route and each technique image from the Worker danielson.

stories.title: Import the app as one snapshot with paraphrased framework text
